testing.context: - On the old code, `test_same_second_messages_are_kept` fails. I ran only that unit test for this check, so the database was not read.

side_effects.context: - `user_data_read`: `data/messages.db`, **message bodies read**. The snapshot fixture in `msgsync/store.load_messages` runs `SELECT id, thread_id, sender, sent_at, body` and loads every row into memory (187,462 messages, including sender names and bodies). It was read once, during the full `pytest` run, and nothing was printed except the row count. I didn't modify or regenerate the file, and it isn't tracked by git.

summary: I fixed the bug, and all 7 tests pass on the fixed code.
